question: What is the nature of scriptural meanings that are accessible to the world?
premises: Scriptural meanings rest on Maya-born Vaikhari speech heard by all.
They take the form of letters, sentences, and words.
Such meanings fall within the range of ordinary worldly cognition.
inference: The scriptural meanings accessible to the world are those expressed through Maya-born Vaikhari speech in the form of letters, sentences, and words.
plain_english: The scriptural meanings that rest on Maya-born Vaikhari speech heard by all, and whose nature is letters, sentences, and words, are within the range of the world.
